title: Aggrega Target-Agnostic Graph (IR)
description: The flattened, fully resolved 1-dimensional graph emitted by the Topology Builder.

aggregate_name.description: The Aggregate's metadata.name. Follows IR snake_case convention.

nodes.description: Dictionary of all application nodes, keyed by their absolute ID. Purely topological.

description.description: Optional developer-authored documentation describing this component instance's role in the application. Passed through from the Aggregate for augmenting rendering and linting diagnostics.

labels.description: The entity's duck-typing and ontology labels.

component.description: The name of the underlying Component.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the Component resolved during compilation.

sync_wave.description: The deployment wave inherited from the IRNode's containing boundary's syncWave field (default 0; negative permitted). Renderers translate the integer to provider-native sequencing artifacts (argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave for K8s/Helm; depends_on for Terraform; DependsOn for CloudFormation; no-op for Compose).

boundary_path.description: The physical spatial hierarchy mapped from the Release boundaries (e.g., 'aws-prod/eks-main/payments'). Allows rendering plugins to generate boundary-aware unique identifiers.

subsystem_path.description: The logical spatial hierarchy mapped from the Aggregate subsystems (e.g., 'finance-module/ledger-api'). Allows rendering plugins to generate logical metadata tags.

catalog_metadata.description: The Enterprise Metadata Suite explicitly extracted from the Catalog entity, exposing lifecycle and ownership data to Wasm linters.

catalog_annotations.description: Immutable, intrinsic component characteristics authored by the Platform Architect in Domain 2.

release_annotations.description: Physical topology strings and Ops realities cascading from boundaries in the Release.

aggregate_annotations.description: Cognitive metadata, developer intent, and FinOps cascading from subsystems in the Aggregate.

edges.description: Explicit logical network paths and dependencies between nodes.

socket.description: The usesSchema category this edge belongs to (e.g., 'databases', 'tools').

alias.description: The developer-defined alias for this connection (e.g., 'primary_db').

origin_feature.description: If this edge was autonomously declared by a Feature (including credential Features labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret), this identifies the Feature instance name. Allows Wasm plugins to isolate their own topology.

inject.description: Agnostic injection routing. Maps local variables to Target provides keys.

feature_markers.description: Explicit canonical strings (e.g., semantic_routing, data_masking) derived from annotations, utilized for downstream Feature Negotiation.

values_mapping.description: The single source of truth for opaque pass-through cognitive payloads, mapped by node ID.

infra_mapping.description: The physical sizing payload injected from the Release, mapped by node ID.

feature_values_mapping.description: Normalized map of Node IDs to their attached Feature configurations.

type.description: The URI of the Catalog Feature.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the Feature resolved during compilation.

values.description: The operational configuration payload for the feature.

infra.description: Physical sizing overrides targeting this feature.

inject.description: Agnostic injection routing. Maps local variables to Target provides keys.

secrets.description: Credentials scoped explicitly to this Feature.

type.description: The URI of the credential Feature interface.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the credential Feature resolved during compilation.

inject.description: Agnostic injection routing. Maps local variables to Target provides keys.

origin.description: Distinguishes Feature attachments authored in a features: block (explicit) from synthetic attachments produced by the annotation-driven expansion pass (annotation).

annotation_key.description: Annotation name that triggered a synthetic attachment (e.g. feature.myco/rewrite-host). Empty when origin is explicit.

annotation_source.description: Source location of the annotation declaration as <release-file-path>:<dotted-yaml-key-path>. Empty when origin is explicit.

secrets.description: Validated credential requests mapped by component node ID, cleanly separated from the standard payload.

type.description: The URI of the credential Feature interface to use.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the credential Feature resolved during compilation.

values.description: Configuration validated by the credential Feature's cueSchema (e.g., path, key).

inject.description: Agnostic injection routing. Maps local variables to Target provides keys.

provenance.description: Traceability metadata for diagnostics and auditing.

compiler_version.description: Mandatory compliance stamp. Identifies the specific Go compiler binary used to generate this graph.

aggregate_version.description: The exact semantic version of the root Aggregate intent used during compilation.

manifest_version.description: The exact semantic version of the Manifest lockfile used during compilation.

release_version.description: The exact semantic version of the Release routing file used during compilation.
